description: Project scaffolding - Initialize the Next.js 14 project with all core dependencies, configuration files, database schema, authentication setup, and base layout with navigation. This establishes the entire project foundation.
steps: Initialize the project with pnpm and create package.json with all dependencies: next@14, react@18, react-dom@18, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, @prisma/client, prisma, next-auth, @next-auth/prisma-adapter, zod, @tanstack/react-query, lucide-react, recharts, date-fns, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu, @radix-ui/react-tabs, @radix-ui/react-select, @radix-ui/react-switch, @radix-ui/react-tooltip, @radix-ui/react-avatar, @radix-ui/react-slot. Dev deps: @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom, eslint, eslint-config-next, prettier, prettier-plugin-tailwindcss, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, @vitejs/plugin-react, jsdom, tailwindcss-animate
Create tsconfig.json with strict mode, path aliases (@/ mapped to src/), and Next.js recommended settings
Create next.config.ts with image domains for avatars, and experimental serverActions enabled

Create tailwind.config.ts with custom theme extending default colors (primary, secondary, accent, destructive, muted, card, popover, border, input, ring), dark mode support via class strategy, and content paths pointing to src/
Create postcss.config.js with tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins
Create src/app/globals.css with Tailwind directives and CSS variables for the design system (light and dark themes using HSL values for shadcn/ui compatibility)
Create .env.example with placeholders for NEXTAUTH_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, TRADOVATE_API_KEY, TRADOVATE_API_SECRET, TRADOVATE_API_URL

Create prisma/schema.prisma with the full data model: User (id, name, email, image, accounts, sessions), Account (NextAuth), Session (NextAuth), VerificationToken (NextAuth), TradingAccount (id, userId, name, platform, accountId, apiKey, apiSecret, balance, status, createdAt, updatedAt), CopyGroup (id, userId, name, description, masterAccountId, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt), CopyGroupMember (id, groupId, tradingAccountId, riskMultiplier, maxLots, maxDailyLoss, isActive), Trade (id, tradingAccountId, externalId, symbol, side, quantity, price, pnl, status, openedAt, closedAt, copiedFromId), and DailyMetric (id, tradingAccountId, date, pnl, trades, winRate, avgWin, avgLoss)
Create src/lib/prisma.ts - Prisma client singleton with global caching for serverless
Create src/lib/auth.ts - NextAuth configuration with Google provider and Prisma adapter, session strategy JWT, callbacks for session and jwt
Create src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts - NextAuth route handler
Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() helper (clsx + tailwind-merge) and formatCurrency, formatDate utility functions
Create src/components/ui/button.tsx - Button component using CVA with variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes
Create src/components/ui/card.tsx - Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter components
Create src/components/ui/badge.tsx - Badge component with variants
Create src/components/ui/input.tsx - Input component with forwardRef
Create src/components/ui/dialog.tsx - Dialog components wrapping Radix UI Dialog
Create src/components/ui/select.tsx - Select components wrapping Radix UI Select
Create src/components/ui/switch.tsx - Switch component wrapping Radix UI Switch
Create src/components/ui/tabs.tsx - Tabs components wrapping Radix UI Tabs
Create src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx - DropdownMenu components wrapping Radix UI
Create src/components/ui/avatar.tsx - Avatar components wrapping Radix UI Avatar
Create src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx - Tooltip components wrapping Radix UI Tooltip

Create src/components/shared/sidebar.tsx - Main navigation sidebar with links to Dashboard, Accounts, Groups, Metrics, Settings. Include user avatar, app logo, and collapse toggle. Use lucide-react icons.
Create src/components/shared/header.tsx - Top header bar with breadcrumb, search input, notifications bell icon, and user dropdown menu
Create src/components/shared/providers.tsx - Client component wrapping SessionProvider and QueryClientProvider
Create src/app/layout.tsx - Root layout with providers, sidebar, header, main content area. Use Inter font from next/font/google. Include metadata.
Create src/app/page.tsx - Landing/redirect page that redirects authenticated users to /dashboard and shows a login page for unauthenticated users
Create src/app/dashboard/page.tsx - Dashboard overview page with placeholder cards for: total PnL, active accounts, active groups, today's trades. Use server component with mock data initially.
Create src/middleware.ts - NextAuth middleware protecting /dashboard, /accounts, /groups, /metrics routes
Create vitest.config.ts with react plugin, jsdom environment, path aliases matching tsconfig, and setup file
Create src/test/setup.ts with @testing-library/jest-dom import
Create src/test/utils.tsx with custom render function that wraps components in necessary providers
Create .eslintrc.json extending next/core-web-vitals with TypeScript rules
Create .prettierrc with semi, singleQuote, tabWidth 2, tailwindcss plugin
Create .gitignore for Next.js project (node_modules, .next, .env.local, prisma/*.db)
Run pnpm install to install all dependencies
Run pnpm prisma generate to generate the Prisma client (will work without a running DB)
Run pnpm build to verify the project compiles successfully
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build compiles the Next.js app without TypeScript errors
The project structure follows Next.js App Router conventions
All shadcn/ui-style components are properly typed and exported
Authentication flow is configured with Google OAuth provider
Database schema covers all required entities: users, trading accounts, copy groups, trades, metrics
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/copy-trading && unset NODE_OPTIONS && pnpm prisma generate
findings: 1. binaries.prisma.sh is blocked in COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - prisma generate cannot download engine binaries. Workaround: created a stub .prisma/client/default.js in the pnpm store that provides a mock PrismaClient for build-time compilation. The real prisma generate must be run in a proper environment with database access. 2. Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com) is also blocked - switched from next/font/google Inter to system font stack with Tailwind fontFamily config. 3. Next.js 14.2.15 does not support next.config.ts - used next.config.mjs instead. 4. @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars rule not available without explicit typescript-eslint plugin - used standard no-unused-vars rule instead.
